Acting here now addresses both the biggest volume-severity combination and a fast-rising trend, making it the clear choice over usability, playback, or access alone.

output.memo_markdown:
## Recommendation

Fix the Premium-only-controls experience for free-tier users: make clear, before someone hits a locked control, which playback features (skip, rewind, song choice, lyrics) are Premium-only, and consider testing limited restoration or trial access to some of these controls for free-tier users. This issue leads all others with 58,940 complaints [C001] and a severity sum of 174,087 [C002], a mean severity of 2.953631 [C003], giving it the top priority score of 174,087 [C004] under the pack's ranking rule. It also carries the largest expressed cancellation intent of any single issue, 11,558 mentions, and its share of monthly complaints has grown sharply in recent months, making it the most urgent and highest-leverage target for next quarter.

## Evidence

Customers describe hitting walls on basic playback actions: one wrote "I am not to move the section of the song. Nor Can I repeat the part I want to listen or start. There is no back button. I need to buy Premium t" (`8964aaea-f4c7-4b01-94e0-a76b992018fd`). Another said "I literally cannot select songs and have to queue them to play anything. And that's if I'm able to get into my library at all. Unacceptable for an app I pay mo" (`d8be33b8-6758-4ae7-9e3e-6e7d02163930`). A third: "I can't actually play the songs I want to because it just plays a different song when I try." (`2d1b5fa6-5d80-4616-9b65-f6e7738e9edf`).

Per the pack's issue definitions, this issue covers controls like song choice, skips, rewind, order, and lyrics being locked behind Premium as a free-tier restriction. This is a product packaging and pricing decision, not a payment-processing or support-ticket failure, even though it is classified under the billing topic by the shared label rule.

Looking at `top_issue_monthly`, the issue's share of monthly complaints stayed roughly steady between 3.3% and 4.8% from mid-2022 through mid-2023 (e.g., 2022-06 at 4.00%, 2023-04 at 3.28%), then rose notably in 2023-06 (7.97%), climbed further in 2023-09 (17.04%), peaked in 2023-10 (29.22%), and remained elevated in 2023-11 (20.75%). The first month (2022-05) and last month (2023-11) are partial, and review volume varies considerably by month (e.g., 2023-07 had 85,005 completed reviews versus 20,837 in 2023-02), so month-to-month share comparisons should be read directionally rather than as precise trend lines.

## Alternatives considered

- **Usability** (ads, redesign, library/queue): the area's largest issues have lower severity sums than the top billing issue (ads: 85,318 [C010]; redesign: 40,105 [C018]) and a lower area mean severity (2.368709) than billing_support (2.890637).
- **Playback** (stops/skips, crashes): high per-complaint severity (means of 3.185217 [C015] and 3.319446 [C023]) but far smaller complaint counts and severity sums than the top issue.
- **Access** (login failures): highest area mean severity (3.838968) of any area, but smallest scale among ranked issues (8,029 complaints [C025], severity sum 31,314 [C026]).

The second-ranked issue overall, general app dissatisfaction, has a larger complaint count (73,774 [C005]) but a lower severity sum (147,625 [C006]) and lower mean severity (2.001044 [C007]) than the top billing issue, and its definition covers general praise, generic criticism, and unrelated or unclear text - it is not an actionable product priority because it does not point to a specific product change.

## Risks and limitations

Label reliability checks show real uncertainty: a 50-case human golden set found topic accuracy of 0.7, with 0 human-labeled billing cases against 5 model-labeled billing cases in that small sample. An independent verifier on a 2,000-review sample found overall topic agreement of 0.8475, and on the top issue specifically, of 252 verified samples, 194 were confirmed same-topic by the verifier. Given the scale of the top issue's lead in complaint count and severity sum over all other issues, this level of disagreement is unlikely to overturn the overall ranking, though it could affect precise counts. All counts are from self-selected public app reviews; cancellation figures reflect expressed intent in review text only, not confirmed churn, revenue, or plan-tier data. No records are reported as pending; 1,596 rows are quarantined and excluded from these counts.

## What to measure next quarter

Track complaint volume and share for ISS-BILLING-PREMIUM_ONLY_CONTROLS monthly against the baseline shares shown here, alongside cancellation-intent mentions for this issue, to see if any tested changes (clearer in-app messaging about Premium-only controls, or limited free-tier control trials) shift either metric.
